target_customer: US sports bettors, later a broader retail audience trading sports event contracts
problem: Traditional sportsbooks set prices with a built-in margin and limit or ban winning bettors. Novig offers a peer to peer exchange with commission free trading and tighter pricing.
business_model: exchange and prediction market, fee and spread based (marketed as commission free to users)
product_category: sports prediction market and betting exchange

founders.name: Jacob Fortinsky
education: Harvard (started the company during his senior year, per Fortune)
founders.background_notes: YC page says experience in investment banking, legislative research and financial trading, and that he was a sports bettor banned from sportsbooks for winning. Employers are not named in the sources opened.

founders.name: Kelechi Ukah
founders.background_notes: YC page and Fortune give no background beyond cofounder and CTO.

competitors.name: Prophet Exchange
competitors.what: New York based peer to peer sports betting exchange

competitors.name: Betfair
competitors.traction_then: exited its only live US market, New Jersey, in September 2020 due to low customer numbers

competitors.name: PredictIt
competitors.what: political prediction market, lost authorisation for non sporting event betting in February 2023

technical_complexity.rationale: A matching engine, pricing and compliance across state sportsbook rules and later CFTC contracts. Standard fintech engineering with hard regulatory parts.

defensibility.rationale: Liquidity on a two sided exchange and regulatory approvals are hard to copy, but incumbents and rivals pursued the same designation.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Sources opened show Kalshi and Polymarket as larger prediction market rivals by 2026 and FanDuel as the sportsbook benchmark. No acquisition of Novig found.

market_need_then: Legal US sports betting was expanding after 2018 and sportsbooks restricted winning bettors, creating demand for exchange style pricing. Source is the YC page description of the founder as a banned bettor.

branding.domain_note: Uses novig.com; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, finance flavored, centered on no commission and transparency.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is a clear shorthand for no vig, and press coverage is frequent, but no source documents mascot, merch or community brand effects.

pivots.to: CFTC regulated sports prediction market launched nationwide
pivots.why: Search coverage says Novig launched a sports exclusive prediction market nationwide and dropped its sweepstakes platform; not opened, treat as approximate.

outcome_analysis: Novig started as a small exchange in the YC Summer 2022 batch and raised $6.4M pre-seed in 2023, then $18M Series A in 2025 and a $75M Series B in 2026 at a reported $500M valuation. It rode the rise of regulated prediction markets and gained CFTC designation, while also fighting state regulators in court. The main risks are state level legal action and larger rivals such as Kalshi and Polymarket.
